item.text: The notification path currently passes the list element into the loader and uses AMD `require`; the loader then toggles through a global component lookup. The modal templates also lack `dropup`, and quick search still uses blur and mousedown state. I found separate, concrete issues in the hash utilities, email formatting, install guard, route wrapper, and templates.

item.text:
I localized the requested changes but did not edit project source or tests: this specialist role is restricted to diagnosis. I recorded the findings in [.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).

- **Notifications:** [header/notifications.js](/app/public/src/client/header/notifications.js:9) passes the list, rather than the clicked trigger, through AMD `require`. [modules/notifications.js](/app/public/src/modules/notifications.js:31) refreshes the list and toggles through a global component lookup. The fix should use `app.require('notifications')`, pass the trigger on open and on initial page load, and keep socket event handling asynchronous. I did not verify a race in a browser.
- **Modal dropdowns and search:** [fork.js](/app/public/src/client/topic/fork.js:23) and [move.js](/app/public/src/client/topic/move.js:23) initialize cached modal elements, while their templates omit `dropup`. [search.js](/app/public/src/modules/search.js:187) relies on blur and mousedown state and retains results after navigation. The [merge template](/app/src/views/modals/merge-topic.tpl:16) does not size its results menu to the input.
- **Server behavior:** [Mongo hash](/app/src/database/mongo/hash.js:143) reads some fields without normalization; [Redis hash](/app/src/database/redis/hash.js:171) passes raw field values to hash operations. [emailer.js](/app/src/emailer.js:352) builds a string `from` for Nodemailer; [install.js](/app/src/install.js:203) dereferences possibly undefined `install.values`; [routes/index.js](/app/src/routes/index.js:71) registers post redirects without `helpers.tryRoute`.
- **Templates:** [admin users](/app/src/views/admin/manage/users.tpl:42) has an unbounded action menu, and [recent_room.tpl](/app/src/views/partials/chats/recent_room.tpl:4) uses a `div` for a navigable room entry. The room entry should become a valid anchor while preserving its click and mark-read behavior.

Existing [hash tests](/app/test/database/hash.js:454) cover empty and undefined fields, but I found no coverage there for numeric or dotted field normalization. No tests were run.
